description: Create a Stripe Checkout link to upgrade an existing submission to Fast-Track ($19.99, published within 48 h, Full refund if rejected.). Creates a live payment session and returns its URL; it charges nobody by itself. Give the URL to the person you are working for and let them pay it — never attempt to complete the payment. Requires a submission_id from submit_pwa that is less than 30 days old.

email.description: Pre-fills the buyer's email on the payment page. Optional — Stripe asks for it otherwise.

submission_id.description: The handle returned by submit_pwa, identifying the listing this payment accelerates.

name: create_pro_launch_checkout
